subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should bundled Google Chat add opt-in all-message Space ingestion through user OAuth or Google Workspace Events/Pub/Sub, and what credential, scope, and config contract should it use?
rationale: The remaining request changes credential storage, OAuth scopes, subscription lifecycle, and visibility of non-mentioned Space messages, which automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Approve plugin-owned OAuth or Events design
options.body: Define an explicit SecretRef-backed config, scope list, setup docs, and event lifecycle before implementing all-message Space ingestion.

options.title: Keep mentioned-message webhook only
options.body: Document the current service-account webhook boundary and close or narrow all-message requests as unsupported for bundled Google Chat.

options.title: Defer to broader Google Workspace auth work
options.body: Keep this issue linked to the canonical OAuth/events design and avoid channel-specific implementation until that design is approved.

recommendation.title: Approve plugin-owned OAuth or Events design
recommendation.body: Define an explicit SecretRef-backed config, scope list, setup docs, and event lifecycle before implementing all-message Space ingestion.

likelyOwner.reason: Most connected to recent Google Chat channel policy, threading, and ingress history among the inspected owners.
